title: Unlike Father, Unlike Son
summary: A prisoner is shot dead while being transported.
method: When the team initially saw the body, the prisoner was not dead, and had broken a packet of fake blood on himself in an attempt to escape. The killer shot him with a silencer while everyone else was trying to chase the non-existent suspect.
motive: The victim killed someone he loved. He was the one who sent the anonymous letter to implicate him in the first place.
notes: Humphrey's Dad shows up, telling him to go home and reunite with his ex-wife, but ends up being impressed by how well he does his job.
